latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.11.0 -->

## What's Changed

## Key Features

### General:
No longer mount HAMI-core to whole GPU allocation, metrics will be exported by NVML directly
Flexible-MIG
Support Cluster Autoscaler
Real-usage monitoring for Flexible-mig workloads

### Remote CUDA:
Allows running vllm on remote cuda

### Schedule:
PodGroup Support
New schedule policy: mutex
Schedule policy combinations
GPU/CPU Numa Align

### Devices:
Full AMD Support
Ascend 950 Support
libvnpu performance optimization



### ✨ Features Details
* ci: allow manual dispatch of the Trivy image scan by @moezdil in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2768
* fix(monitor): replace MustNewConstMetric with safe helper and track InitContainers by @devGPP23 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2716
* feat(scheduler): account native sidecar container GPU resources by @maishivamhoo123 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2723
* Add nil node checks to PatchNodeAnnotations and RemoveNodeAnnotation by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2792
* feat: add groundwork for NUMA-aware device refit by @saiyam1814 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2729

* test(util): add unit tests for GetNode() function by @Kevindua26 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2798
* [kind/bug] Restore model-aware scheduling for Cambricon MLU devices by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2780
* [Feature] Add Prometheus metrics for scheduler leader and cache sync state by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2758
* Feat/scheduler poddisruptionbudget by @im-Toqeer-506 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2773
* feat: add host PID broker server and device plugin integration by @iemAnshuman in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2417
* test(device): add unit tests for ReplaceUsage and GetResourceQuota by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2825
* feat(e2e): add MIG E2E targets and fix GPU preflight fail-fast by @haitwang-cloud in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2742
* [Feature] Expose Hardware Health and Error Metrics in vGPUmonitor (Fixes #2717) by @Gurkaran18 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2732
* feat(device plugin): add auto detecting nvidiaDriverRoot by @FouoF in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2848
* test(scheduler): verify NUMA refit PATCH timeout releases allocLock by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2869
* webhook: validate device-scoring-weights at admission by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2827
* feat(nvidia): score MIG placements and add backtracking fallback. by @maishivamhoo123 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2855
* test(scheduler): add Go benchmarks for the Filter scoring path by @im-Toqeer-506 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2907
* feat(dashboard): compare allocated and host GPU memory by @Utkarsh56016 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2922
* Add template to vNPU-mode by @archlitchi in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2970
* feat(helm): add OpenShift &SELinux helm chart support by @spencercjh in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2208
* Cleanup: Replace %v with %w in fmt.Errorf() for better error handling by @Kevindua26 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2998
* test(e2e): add scheduler policy E2E suite by @haitwang-cloud in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2793
* feat(chart): expose node-lock-retry-timeout and extender httpTimeout by @im-Toqeer-506 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2944

Formerly known as `k8s-vGPU-scheduler`, HAMi helps platform teams share expensive GPUs and other AI accelerators across Kubernetes workloads, isolate device memory and compute, and schedule pods with device-aware policies without changing application code. HAMi is a [CNCF Incubating](https://www.cncf.io/projects/) and [CNCF Landscape](https://landscape.cncf.io/?item=orchestration-management--scheduling-orchestration--hami) project. It is also listed in the [CNAI Landscape](https://landscape.cncf.io/?group=cnai&item=cnai--general-orchestration--hami). ![CNCF logo](imgs/cncf-logo.png) ## Documentation - [Architecture](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/core-concepts/architecture) - [GPU virtualization](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/core-concepts/gpu-virtualization) - [Supported devices and vendor guides](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/device-supported) - [Prerequisites](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/prerequisites) - [Install and run a first workload](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/get-started/deploy-with-helm) - [Upgrade and migrate values](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/upgrade) - [Configuration and operations](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/configure) - [NVIDIA scheduling policies](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/nvidia-device/scheduling-policy) - [NVIDIA dynamic MIG](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/nvidia-device/dynamic-mig-support) - [Device allocation metrics](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/device-allocation) - [Device usage metrics](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/real-time-device-usage) - [Grafana dashboards](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/grafana-dashboard) - [WebUI](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/hami-webui-user-guide) - [Volcano integration](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/how-to-use-volcano-vgpu) - [Kueue integration](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/kueue/how-to-use-kueue) - [Benchmarks](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/benchmark) - [Troubleshooting](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/troubleshooting) - [Uninstall](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/uninstall) ## Repository resources - [Chart values reference](charts/hami/README.md) - [Workload examples](examples/) - [Agent skills](skill/) - [HAMi-WebUI repository](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi-WebUI) ## Roadmap, Governance, And Contributing HAMi is governed by [maintainers](./MAINTAINERS.md) and [contributors](./AUTHORS.md).
